# World Population Review

> > Comprehensive demographic data and population statistics for countries, cities, states, and continents worldwide.

World Population Review provides up-to-date population rankings, demographic analysis, and statistical information for urban areas, administrative regions, and geographic territories across the globe. The site offers detailed breakdowns of population trends, city rankings, and comparative demographic data for 2026 and beyond.

## Key Topics

- population statistics
- demographics
- city rankings
- urban population
- 2026 population data
- United States
- Ukraine cities
- state population
- continental demographics
- urban areas
- Japan cities
- Pakistan cities
- geographic population trends
- metropolitan statistics

## Continental & Regional Population

- [North America Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/continents/north-america): Continental demographics covering USA, Canada, and North America region

## U.S. State Demographics

- [Georgia Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/states/georgia): Demographics and population statistics for Georgia state and Atlanta

## European Cities

- [Ukraine Cities by Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/cities/ukraine): Population rankings for Ukrainian cities including Kiev, Kharkiv, Odessa

## Asian Cities

- [Japan Cities by Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/cities/japan): Population rankings for Japanese cities including Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya
- [Pakistan Cities by Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/cities/pakistan): Population rankings for Pakistani cities including Karachi, Lahore
